field_rules.content: P1 text verbatim - no normalize, no rewrite, no classification

source_filter.reason: P1 primary layer (atomic_text.py docstring); basis of P2 bundle facts

not_exposed_in_v1: style_signature (P3 function not on frozen whitelist)
font fields (stay in P1 source; minimal schema)

field_rules.bbox: PyMuPDF block bbox verbatim under frozen _round_bbox convention

NON_TEXT_BLOCK_ATOM.enumeration: page.get_text('dict') blocks with type != 0; same parse surface as frozen P1 _extract_block_observations

region_fact.semantic_type_names: forbidden - no TABLE_REGION / GRAPHIC_REGION / FIGURE_REGION or any is_* role
region_fact.arbitration: forbidden - multiple detectors coexist; layer never selects truth

IN_REGION.definition: contained = (region.bbox[0] <= atom_center_x <= region.bbox[2]) and (region.bbox[1] <= atom_center_y <= region.bbox[3]); atom center = ((bbox[0]+bbox[2])/2, (bbox[1]+bbox[3])/2) over frozen coordinates
IN_REGION.registered_exception: center-point predicate over frozen coordinates, sanctioned by contract section 4.1

components.grouping: frozen P2 same_y_band output (y_center diff <= 3.0, GeometryConfig frozen); consumed as anchor-neighborhood sets {anchor} U same_y_band_members(anchor), unique frozensets, deterministic
components.gap: frozen compute_pairwise(a,b).horizontal_distance verbatim (edge gap, overlap=0) - zero gap math in layer

GAP_SEQUENCE.input: one page TEXT_ATOM set with full (non-truncated) P2 bundle
GAP_SEQUENCE.thresholds: NONE in measurement - uniformity/CV/equispacing judgments are hypothesis-side
GAP_SEQUENCE.version_rule: any component change => measurement_identity_version++ (no silent v1 update)

versions.query_version: hypothesis-side; layer does not perceive or record it

known_limitations: vector drawings (page.get_drawings) not covered - same surface limitation as frozen P1 block layer
raster content unreachable (no OCR) - presence/bbox only
P3 style_signature not exposed in v1 (P3 functions not on frozen whitelist)
P2 truncated artifacts (max_pairwise=2000) expose singles only; GAP_SEQUENCE refuses them
